patterns.description: La estructura de fees del canal móvil de Gumroad (40% total: 10% Gumroad + 30% App Store/Google Play) co-ocurre con señales de sellers que perciben los fees como elevados y migran hacia otras plataformas. El bloqueador es la política de fees de app store documentada en cards de plataforma; lo bloqueado son sellers que reportan erosión de margen o migración en cards de seller.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-036: Gumroad help center: 40% total fee for mobile app sales (10% Gumroad + 30% App Store/Google Play)
signal_summaries.SC-R1-038: Gumroad Discover mobile app: 40% fee, $100 price cap, no refunds, all app sales final
signal_summaries.SC-R1-047: Seller paid $16.59 in fees from $110 total sales, commentary on fee growth at higher volumes
signal_summaries.SC-R1-061: Seller perceived Gumroad fees as high, migrated back to Lemon Squeezy once approved

patterns.routing_rationale: Blocker documented in platform cards (SC-R1-036, SC-R1-038): 40% mobile app fee structure. Blocked documented in seller cards (SC-R1-047, SC-R1-061): fee erosion and platform migration. Actor values differ: platform (blocker pole) vs seller (blocked pole). Different actor values → passes same-actor filter. Both sides have card support with documented mechanism.

components.label: Blocker — fee structure del canal móvil
components.summary: Platform policy: 40% fee on mobile app sales (10% Gumroad + 30% App Store/Google Play), $100 price cap on Discover mobile app, no seller-issued refunds

components.label: Blocked — sellers con margen erosionado o migración documentada
components.summary: Seller self-reports: fee impact on margin ($16.59 from $110), migration away from Gumroad citing high fees

patterns.description: La política de Gumroad de no activar Discover hasta que el seller alcanza su primera venta (o $10 en ingresos) co-ocurre con sellers que reportan cero tráfico orgánico a pesar de tener múltiples listings. El bloqueador es la política de eligibilidad de Discover documentada en cards de plataforma; lo bloqueado son sellers sin primera venta que no acceden a exposición orgánica.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-055: Seller states Gumroad will not promote via Discover until seller earns first $10; no free exposure before threshold
signal_summaries.SC-R1-062: Seller with 26 products reports zero organic views and zero Discover views; attributes to Discover threshold before first sale
signal_summaries.SC-R1-049: Seller with 35 listings reports zero organic traffic (zero footfall)
signal_summaries.SC-R1-073: Gumroad help center: products listed on Discover once unspecified eligibility criteria are satisfied

patterns.routing_rationale: Blocker documented in platform card (SC-R1-073) and seller-reported policy (SC-R1-055): Discover eligibility threshold. Blocked documented in seller cards (SC-R1-062, SC-R1-049): zero organic traffic despite multiple products. Actor values differ: platform/seller (blocker pole) vs seller (blocked pole). SC-R1-073 actor=platform, SC-R1-055 actor=seller, SC-R1-062 actor=seller, SC-R1-049 actor=seller. Blocker pole contains platform actor; blocked pole contains seller actor. Different actor values → passes same-actor filter.

components.label: Blocked — sellers sin tráfico orgánico pre-primera venta
components.summary: Sellers with 26 and 35 products respectively report zero organic/Discover views

patterns.description: La política de pago de Gumroad (solo direct deposit o PayPal; Payoneer, Wise, wire no soportados) co-ocurre con sellers en países donde PayPal no está disponible que no pueden recibir pagos. El bloqueador es la política de payout documentada en cards de plataforma; lo bloqueado son sellers en geografías no cubiertas.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-024: Gumroad help center: if direct deposit unavailable and PayPal unavailable in seller's country, there is currently no way to pay the seller
signal_summaries.SC-R1-025: Gumroad help center: Payoneer, Wise, check, money order, wire transfer not supported as payout methods
signal_summaries.SC-R1-027: Gumroad help center: payout method by country (direct bank or debit in listed countries; verified PayPal for all others)
signal_summaries.SC-R1-028: Gumroad help center: if PayPal not supported in seller's country, Gumroad cannot pay them; Payoneer, wire, bitcoin unavailable

patterns.routing_rationale: Blocker documented in platform cards: payout infrastructure limited to direct deposit and PayPal. Blocked: sellers in countries where both are unavailable receive no payment. All 4 cards have actor=platform. Same actor across all signal IDs → same_actor_discrepancy. Route to rejected_grouping.

patterns.description: La política de reembolsos de Gumroad (plataforma puede emitir reembolsos dentro de 90 días anulando política del seller; sellers responsables de reembolsar a Gumroad por chargebacks) co-ocurre con sellers que reportan suspensiones de cuenta y dificultad para recuperar fondos. El bloqueador es la política de refunds/chargebacks documentada en platform cards; lo bloqueado son sellers afectados documentados en seller cards.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-034: Gumroad help center: platform reserves right to issue refunds within 90 days even if seller has no-refund policy
signal_summaries.SC-R1-018: Gumroad ToS: sellers responsible for reimbursing Gumroad for refunds, chargebacks, disputes
signal_summaries.SC-R1-046: Blog: many Gumroad users faced delayed payouts, poor customer support, account suspensions without clear reasons
signal_summaries.SC-R1-029: Gumroad help center: on suspension for high chargeback rate, balance held 30-45 days

patterns.routing_rationale: Blocker documented in platform cards (SC-R1-034, SC-R1-018, SC-R1-029): Gumroad's unilateral refund/chargeback policy and balance holds. Blocked documented in seller card (SC-R1-046): delayed payouts, suspensions, difficulty recovering funds. Actor values: SC-R1-034=platform, SC-R1-018=platform, SC-R1-029=platform, SC-R1-046=seller. Different actor values → passes same-actor filter.
